caption:
Everything I'm building right now, in one Reel.

Burnline: a satellite simulator checked against the textbook to 1 meter. Live in your browser.
{flow}: an AI that turns rough notes into polished performance statements. Live.
Wisp: an animated face for a Raspberry Pi voice assistant.
Ghost: a talking Destiny Ghost. Designed, 12 parts generated by code, first print next.

And this Reel edited itself. Software I wrote pulled the clips from my project repos, cut them to the beat and rendered it. No editor.

Send this to the friend who's been "about to start" a side project for a year.

Fan project for the Ghost. Destiny belongs to Bungie.
